q: The no-cloning theorem in quantum information states that:
opts: There is no unitary operation that perfectly copies an arbitrary unknown quantum state
Quantum computation is slower than classical
exp: No-cloning: there is no unitary U such that U|ψ⟩|0⟩ = |ψ⟩|ψ⟩ for all |ψ⟩. This distinguishes quantum from classical information and is why quantum cryptography can detect eavesdroppers.
